entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 6261 of 2023
Applicant :- Rahul Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Sumit Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A., Akhand Pratap Singh, Sharad Nandan Ojha
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sharad Nandan Ojha, learned counsel for the informant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.
In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the applicant used to harass the wife of the informant and despite repeated complaints nothing was done, as such, she committed suicide.

3. The counsel for the applicant argues that the deceased had lodged an FIR against the applicant for the offence under Section 376 IPC at the instance of her husband (informant herein), however during trial she did not support the prosecution story, as such, she was harassed by her own family Rahul Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

The cause of death as per the post mortem report is ante mortem hanging.
4. Learned A.G.A. as well as the counsel for the informant opposed the bail prayer.
5. Considering the allegation in the FIR, even if treated to gospel truth for the sake of argument would not construed abetment as defined under Section 107 IPC.

Considering the law as explained in the case of Mariano Anto Bruno and another Vs. Inspector of Police : 2022 SCC Online SC 1387,
the applicant is enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Mariano Anto Bruno and another Vs. Inspector of Police : 2022 SCC Online SC 1387
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Rahul Kumar be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 0722 of 2022, under Sections 306, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Pratapgarh, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.7.2024 Arun  Rahul Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.
